name: Order saved, event never sent (dual write and outbox)
description: An order is first written to the database, then an "order placed" message goes to a queue for the shipping worker. These are two separate calls: at 20 s the queue goes down for 20 s. Orders are still saved, but their messages cannot be sent (see the API's "Data and message disagree"): the user sees an error and orders again, and shipping never hears about the first order. Try this: set the API's "Message after write" to "On (transactional outbox)": the message is written in the same transaction as the order, and a relay sends it to the queue, catching up after the queue is back. Users no longer see errors and do not wait for the queue.
